title: Second-page coproduct comparison for lower-truncated direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $E_i\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] have an ambient coproduct cofan $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. Using canonical lower truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], for every $a,r\in\mathbb Z$ and $p\in\mathbb N$, with $Rf_*$ as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image], the canonical map $\bigoplus_i H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}E_i)[0]))\to H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}S)[0]))$ induced by $H^r(\tau_{\ge a}\iota_i)$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08DZ, bounded-below spectral-sequence reduction, with Tag 015J

proof.text: Apply the monomorphism and epimorphism halves to the same canonical comparison. In the abelian category of module sheaves, a morphism that is both mono and epi is an isomorphism, by CategoryTheory.isIso_of_mono_of_epi.

theorem truncated_directImage_secondPage_coproduct
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) (a : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) :
    IsIso (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f (p : ℤ)).map
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) r).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).map (ι i)))))
